c1.title: AI-powered rostering
c1.bg: Manual scheduling for a large workforce was slow and error-prone — constantly fighting labor regulations and rarely reflecting what employees actually wanted.
c1.did: We built an AI rostering system that automatically balances employee preferences with labor regulations, producing compliant schedules in minutes.
c1.out: Manual scheduling workload cut by 80–90%, with better fairness and compliance.

c2.title: Conversational booking & customer service
c2.bg: Customer service teams worked across scattered systems, re-entering booking details by hand — limiting how much they could handle and slowing sales.
c2.did: We unified the systems and used AI to extract booking details directly from customer conversations, completing reservations in real time.
c2.out: Less headcount needed, far higher service capacity, faster responses — and higher sales.
c2.o2: Higher service capacity with less headcount

c3.title: AI-assisted design optimization
c3.bg: Pharmaceutical and semiconductor facilities need clean-room layouts — precise, compliant, and expensive to produce by hand.
c3.did: We built an AI-assisted design tool that generates optimized clean-room layouts quickly.
c3.out: Lower design cost and compressed timelines, without compromising compliance.

c1.title: AI 智能排班
c1.bg: 为大规模员工手动排班既慢又容易出错——既要不断满足劳动法规，又很难照顾员工的实际诉求。
c1.did: 我们构建了一套 AI 排班系统，自动平衡员工诉求与劳动法规，几分钟内生成合规排班表。
c1.out: 人工排班工作量降低 80–90%，公平性与合规性同步提升。

c2.title: 对话式预订与客服
c2.bg: 客服团队在多个割裂的系统中工作，预订信息需要手动重复录入——承接能力受限，销售也因此变慢。
c2.did: 我们整合了所有系统，用 AI 直接从客服对话中提炼预订信息，实时完成预订。
c2.out: 更少的人力投入、更高的承接能力、更快的响应——以及更高的销量。
c2.o1: 在对话内直接完成预订
c2.o2: 更少人力，更高承接能力

c3.title: AI 辅助设计优化
c3.bg: 药企与半导体行业需要洁净室（Clean Room）设计——精确、合规，而手工制作既慢又贵。
c3.did: 我们打造了一款 AI 辅助设计工具，快速生成优化的洁净室排版方案。
c3.out: 更低的成本、更短的周期，同时不牺牲合规性。
c3.o1: 药企与半导体的洁净室设计
c3.o3: 更低的成本，更快的交付
